design: train off-target predictor on rat GSE184929 (seed UAUAGAG), zero-shot test on human Patel GSE164289 / GSE196839 (seed GGGGGC); features = [species-matched seed-match abundance, magnetic-PPR propagated seed signal over human TRRUST at charge q]; logistic regression, target log2FC < 0; AUROC for human log2FC direction.
magnetic_operator: P_mag(q) = alpha (alpha I + (1-alpha) L_q^sigma)^(-1) on human TRRUST (2072 nodes), alpha=0.15; feature = |P_mag(q) e| at the gene's node
species_matched_3utr: rat seed counts vs rat Rnor_6.0 3'UTRs; human seed counts vs GRCh38/104 3'UTRs (pyensembl)
wasserstein_note: rat abundance = UAUAGAG (7mer) site counts; human = GCCCCC (6mer) site counts; the gap includes the seed-length difference, not only the species 3'UTRs.

stop_condition.ruling: Cross-species AUROC stays below 0.6: T5 is DEMOTED from a theorem to a NUMERICAL OBSERVATION; it must NOT be framed as a theorem.
